text_block_list.text: Pant... Pant... Hmm...
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Not a bad result, if I do say so myself.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало
choice_data_list: The results demonstrate how talented you are.

text_block_list.text:
Hmph, precisely. And it's about time,
too. After
all, I'm a first-ra—
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Кинг Хало! You did it!
text_block_list.name: Fan A

text_block_list.text:
What's your next race, King? Come on,
tell us!
text_block_list.name: Fan B

text_block_list.text:
Where do you plan to leave the Mark of
the King
next?
text_block_list.name: Fan C

text_block_list.text:
Hehe. "Mark of the King"? I don't
remember
saying such a phrase to the
media before.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало
choice_data_list: They can't get enough of you, King.

text_block_list.text: You're right. This is just how my fans are.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Excuse me for a moment.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Well then...
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Huh? Кинг Хало?! Why are you here?
text_block_list.name: Staff A

text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, but we have to prepare for the
next
race...
text_block_list.name: Staff B

text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, I won't be long. I just want
to
interact with the fans a moment.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Whoa! King seems like a real big shot,
huh?
text_block_list.name: Spectator D

text_block_list.text: Hehe, now now, I am a big shot. Don't get it confused now.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
For I am Кинг Хало, a first-rate
Umamusume!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! Now, I'm sure you're dying to
hear
about what's next in my career!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Yeah!
text_block_list.name: Spectators

text_block_list.text:
Well then, I'll tell you! My next race will
be the
Sprinters Stakes!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
I'll kick off the autumn G1 season by
proving my
dominance yet again as the
king of the sprint!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Whether it be spring or autumn, I, King
Halo, will
be the first to charm you all!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
So, what do you think? The Sprinters
Stakes
sounds like a good plan, right?
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало
choice_data_list: If that's your path, then so be it.

text_block_list.text:
Really? After everything we've gone
through,
that's the best response you
can give me?
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
You should know better than anyone
that I am
confident in my decisions.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало
